digest.component_or_area: plan review gate / det_floor module split
propositions: det_floor.py at 793 LOC exceeds sustainable size; must split along the blocking vs never-blocking DET check boundary to restore headroom under the 800-LOC hard cap
The four never-blocking checks (p2, p3, p6, p7) form a closed call-graph cluster with zero edges to the retained blocking checks; moving them severs no dependencies

Existing test files monkeypatch det_floor module attributes (DET_CHECKS, run_det_floor, est_tokens) and import helpers (_clarity_score, _count_ac_items, _description_limit) from det_floor; all six must remain in det_floor.py to avoid breaking test instrumentation

p6_ac_quality calls bare names (vague_hits_in_line, _lint_verify_command, _verify_command_strings) bound by det_floor's module-level imports; det_advisory.py must declare these imports itself to avoid NameError

Path-keyed registries (.github/complexity-baseline.json, .github/module-size-limit.txt) require no updates because no baseline ceiling exists for det_floor.py and the module-size gate enumerates via rglob
